entries.body:
# Blood Scent

## Overview
Blood Scent is the first true hunting technique taught to every Bloodhunter. Through the practice of Sangramancy, their senses evolve beyond those of ordinary mortals, allowing them to perceive the lingering scent carried within freshly spilled blood. To a Bloodhunter, every drop of blood tells a story, revealing the direction a creature has fled and hinting at the emotions it carried when it was shed.

Unlike common trackers who rely upon footprints or broken branches, a Bloodhunter follows the scent of blood itself. Rain may wash away tracks, wind may erase scent, and darkness may hide a quarry, but fresh blood leaves behind a trail that Sangramancy can awaken. Once the Bloodhunter discovers that trail, the hunt truly begins.

Should the Bloodhunter wish to know more than the scent alone can reveal, they may perform a sacred Sangramancy ritual known as **Blood Communion**. By absorbing a fragment of a creature's blood into themselves, the Bloodhunter experiences echoes of the creature's life force, committing its unique Blood Signature to memory. This knowledge comes at a price, for every Blood Communion strengthens the emotions carried within the blood and brings the hunter one step closer to Bloodlust.

Every great hunt begins with a single drop of blood.

## Rank 1
### Description

Blood Scent is the first true hunting technique taught to every Bloodhunter. Through the practice of Sangramancy, their senses evolve beyond those of ordinary mortals, allowing them to perceive the lingering scent carried within freshly spilled blood. To a Bloodhunter, every drop of blood tells a story, revealing the direction a creature has fled and hinting at the emotions it carried when it was shed.

Unlike common trackers who rely upon footprints or broken branches, a Bloodhunter follows the scent of blood itself. Rain may wash away tracks, wind may erase scent, and darkness may hide a quarry, but fresh blood leaves behind a trail that Sangramancy can awaken. Once the Bloodhunter discovers that trail, the hunt truly begins.

Should the Bloodhunter wish to know more than the scent alone can reveal, they may perform a sacred Sangramancy ritual known as **Blood Communion**. By absorbing a fragment of a creature's blood into themselves, the Bloodhunter experiences echoes of the creature's life force, committing its unique Blood Signature to memory. This knowledge comes at a price, for every Blood Communion strengthens the emotions carried within the blood and brings the hunter one step closer to Bloodlust.

Every great hunt begins with a single drop of blood.

### Effects

- Blood Scent is a **Passive Talent** and is always active.
- You can detect the scent of **fresh blood** within **10 metres**.
- You can follow trails created by fresh blood, even when ordinary tracks have been lost.
- You may identify the general direction a bleeding creature has travelled by following the scent of its blood.
- While actively following a blood trail, gain:
  - **+2 to Survival checks** made to track the creature.
  - **+2 to Perception checks** made to locate the creature.
- Blood Scent cannot detect creatures that have left **no blood trail**.
- You may perform **Blood Communion** on fresh blood no older than **24 hours**.
- Blood Communion requires:
  - **10 MP**
  - **1 minute of uninterrupted concentration**
- Upon completing Blood Communion:
  - You memorise that creature's unique **Blood Signature**.
  - If this is the first creature of its species you have communed with, you permanently add that species to your **Blood Codex**.
  - Gain **5 Blood Points (BP)** as you absorb the emotional resonance carried within the blood.
- You may maintain **one Active Blood Signature** at a time.
- While hunting a creature whose Blood Signature you have memorised, gain **+1 to Attack Rolls** against that creature.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, apprentices are forbidden from performing Blood Communion until they have first mastered Blood Scent. Elders believe that a hunter who cannot follow blood has no right to absorb it. Only after proving they can complete a hunt through patience and discipline are they permitted to experience the deeper mysteries of Sangramancy.

The ritual of Blood Communion is both revered and feared. As the blood dissolves into crimson mana, fragments of the creature's emotions briefly become the Bloodhunter's own. Terror from fleeing prey, rage from a wounded beast, or the unnatural hunger of a vampire may all be felt for a fleeting moment. Every communion leaves behind another echo within the Bloodhunter's soul.

Veteran Bloodhunters maintain a mental archive known as the **Blood Codex**, an ever-growing collection of Blood Signatures gathered throughout their lives. To them, every hunt is more than a victory—it is another lesson preserved forever. Yet every lesson carries a cost, for no Bloodhunter can absorb another creature's essence without also carrying a piece of its burden.

> *"Steel wins battles. Blood wins hunts. Learn the blood, and no prey will remain hidden from you."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

As a Bloodhunter's understanding of Sangramancy deepens, Blood Scent evolves from a simple hunting instinct into a supernatural connection with the essence carried within blood. Every trail becomes clearer, every lingering scent more distinct, and every Blood Signature easier to distinguish from the countless others that stain the world.

At this level, the Bloodhunter no longer needs to dedicate themselves to a single quarry. Their growing Blood Codex allows them to retain multiple Blood Signatures simultaneously, making it possible to pursue several hunts without abandoning previous knowledge. Experienced Bloodhunters often compare this to recognising familiar voices in a crowded room—each Blood Signature possesses its own unmistakable identity.

Blood Communion also reveals more than simple identity. The Bloodhunter begins to understand the condition of the creature that shed the blood. A single drop can reveal signs of exhaustion, illness, corruption, or injury, allowing the hunter to prepare long before the prey is ever seen.

To outsiders, Bloodhunters appear impossibly persistent. They do not simply follow tracks—they follow the lingering echoes of life itself.

### Effects

- Blood Scent remains a **Passive Talent**.
- You can detect the scent of **fresh blood** within **20 metres**.
- Blood trails remain detectable for up to **48 hours**, provided they have not been completely destroyed by powerful magic.
- You may maintain **two Active Blood Signatures** at a time.
- While hunting a creature whose Blood Signature you have memorised, you gain:
  - **+2 to Survival checks** made to track that creature.
  - **+2 to Perception checks** made to locate that creature.
  - **+2 to Attack Rolls** against that creature.
- Blood Communion now reveals:
  - The creature's approximate size.
  - Whether it is healthy, wounded, diseased, corrupted, or poisoned.
  - Whether the blood belongs to a Humanoid, Beast, Monstrosity, Dragon, Fey, Fiend, Undead, Aberration, or another recognised creature type.
- Blood Communion requires:
  - **10 MP**
  - **1 minute of uninterrupted concentration**
- Completing Blood Communion generates **6 Blood Points (BP)**.
- If the creature's species is not already recorded, it is permanently added to your **Blood Codex**.

### Lore

Senior Bloodhunters often say that Rank II marks the beginning of true mastery. The hunter no longer relies solely upon instinct but begins building a lifetime of knowledge through their ever-growing Blood Codex. Every successful communion expands their understanding of the creatures that roam Asteria, making future hunts more efficient and far more dangerous for their prey.

Many Orders preserve the Blood Codices of legendary Bloodhunters after their deaths, allowing future generations to study centuries of accumulated knowledge. While the memories of the hunter fade with time, the lessons written in blood endure.

Yet each Blood Communion continues to exact its toll. Every absorbed Blood Signature leaves behind another fragment of emotion within the hunter's soul. The Bloodhunter learns to carry these burdens with discipline, knowing that one day the weight of too many memories may awaken the chilling calm of Bloodlust.

> *"Every hunt teaches a lesson. Every lesson is written in blood. The wise hunter never stops reading."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

At the Third Rank, Blood Scent becomes far more than an exceptional hunting instinct—it becomes an extension of the Bloodhunter's own consciousness. Every Blood Signature committed to the Blood Codex strengthens the hunter's understanding of the creatures they pursue, allowing them to distinguish one individual from another even amongst members of the same species.

A Bloodhunter no longer follows blood alone. Tiny traces left upon weapons, armour, footprints, or vegetation are enough to awaken the lingering scent carried within a creature's life essence. Once a Blood Signature has been memorised, the Bloodhunter develops an almost supernatural intuition for that prey's movements, instinctively predicting where it will flee and recognising attempts to disguise or mislead the hunt.

Blood Communion also reveals far deeper truths. As fragments of emotion and instinct flow into the Bloodhunter, they begin to understand the creature itself. They can recognise corrupted blood, unnatural mutations, lingering curses, and even signs that another Bloodhunter has previously hunted the same prey.

Veterans often describe this stage as the point where the hunt becomes inevitable. Once a Bloodhunter has learned your Blood Signature, escaping is no longer a matter of speed—it becomes a matter of luck.

### Effects

- Blood Scent remains a **Passive Talent**.
- You can detect the scent of **fresh blood** within **30 metres**.
- Blood trails remain detectable for up to **72 hours**, unless removed by powerful magical means.
- You may maintain **three Active Blood Signatures** at a time.
- While hunting a creature whose Blood Signature you have memorised, you gain:
  - **+3 to Survival checks** made to track that creature.
  - **+3 to Perception checks** made to locate that creature.
  - **+2 to Attack Rolls** against that creature.
  - **+2 to Damage Rolls** against that creature.
- You have Advantage on checks made to follow a Blood Signature through difficult terrain or poor weather.
- Blood Communion now reveals:
  - Approximate age of the blood.
  - Signs of magical corruption, curses, disease, or mutation.
  - Whether multiple creatures have mixed blood at the scene.
- Blood Communion requires:
  - **10 MP**
  - **1 minute of uninterrupted concentration**
- Completing Blood Communion generates **8 Blood Points (BP)**.
- If the creature's species is not already recorded, it is permanently added to your **Blood Codex**.

### Lore

Only experienced Bloodhunters reach the Third Rank, for it requires absolute trust in one's Sangramancy. The Blood Codex has grown into a vast archive of living memories, each Blood Signature becoming another lesson preserved within the hunter's soul. Some masters claim they can recall the scent of a creature hunted decades earlier as clearly as if the blood had been spilled moments ago.

Blood Communion becomes increasingly dangerous at this stage. The emotions absorbed from prey linger longer than before, occasionally surfacing during moments of silence or meditation. While disciplined Bloodhunters learn to separate their own thoughts from those carried within the blood, many become haunted by echoes of every creature they have ever hunted.

Despite the danger, Rank III is widely regarded as the point where a Bloodhunter truly earns the title of Master Hunter. Few creatures can escape once their blood has been committed to the Codex, and fewer still survive long enough to be hunted a second time.

> *"A trail may fade. Footprints may vanish. But blood never forgets who it belongs to."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

At the Fourth Rank, Blood Scent transcends mortal instinct and becomes an art perfected through decades of relentless hunts. Every Blood Signature committed to the Blood Codex deepens the Bloodhunter's understanding of life itself, allowing them to perceive not only where prey has travelled, but how it lived, fought, suffered, and survived.

The Bloodhunter no longer follows obvious blood trails alone. The faintest trace upon a weapon's hilt, a single crimson droplet caught beneath a leaf, or dried blood hidden within ancient stone is enough to awaken the memory of its owner. To the Bloodhunter, every battlefield becomes a library written in blood, each stain another page waiting to be read.

Blood Communion reaches an advanced level of mastery. By absorbing another creature's blood, the Bloodhunter can sense far more than identity. They instinctively understand the strength flowing through the creature's veins, recognise ancient bloodlines, and identify signs of magical alteration, corruption, curses, diseases, or unnatural evolution. Few secrets remain hidden from one who understands the language of blood.

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, reaching this rank is known as becoming a **Crimson Tracker**—a hunter capable of pursuing prey across kingdoms, through dense wilderness, and into the darkest ruins with unwavering certainty.

### Effects

- Blood Scent remains a **Passive Talent**.
- You can detect the scent of **fresh blood** within **50 metres**.
- Blood trails remain detectable for up to **7 days**, unless removed by powerful magical means.
- You may maintain **five Active Blood Signatures** at a time.
- While hunting a creature whose Blood Signature you have memorised, you gain:
  - **+4 to Survival checks** made to track that creature.
  - **+4 to Perception checks** made to locate that creature.
  - **+3 to Attack Rolls** against that creature.
  - **+3 to Damage Rolls** against that creature.
- You have Advantage on checks made to pursue your Marked Prey through difficult terrain, darkness, storms, or other natural obstacles.
- Blood Communion now reveals:
  - The creature's approximate power compared to your own.
  - Magical corruption, diseases, curses, mutations, and bloodline alterations.
  - Whether the blood belongs to a creature currently under magical influence or possession.
  - The approximate time since the blood was shed.
- Blood Communion requires:
  - **10 MP**
  - **1 minute of uninterrupted concentration**
- Completing Blood Communion generates **10 Blood Points (BP)**.
- If the creature's species is not already recorded, it is permanently added to your **Blood Codex**.
- Once a creature type has been permanently recorded within your Blood Codex, you automatically recognise blood belonging to that species without needing to perform Blood Communion again.

### Lore

Only the greatest Bloodhunters ever attain the Fourth Rank. By now, the Blood Codex has become a living archive of countless hunts, each Blood Signature adding another lesson to a lifetime devoted to protecting the world from horrors that ordinary warriors cannot comprehend.

Senior Bloodhunters often describe Blood Communion as less of a ritual and more of a conversation. The blood willingly reveals its history to those who have earned the right to hear it. Every triumph, every wound, every curse, and every drop of corruption leaves an echo waiting to be interpreted by an experienced Crimson Tracker.

Yet every lesson carries a burden. The Bloodhunter's own Blood Points continue to accumulate with each Communion, each hunt, and each use of Sangramancy. Veterans know that knowledge itself is dangerous, for the more blood one understands, the louder the whispers of Bloodlust become.

> *"A novice follows blood. A master listens to it. Every drop has a story—few possess the wisdom to understand what it is trying to say."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

At the pinnacle of Sangramancy, the Bloodhunter no longer merely follows blood—they understand it. Every Blood Signature committed to their Blood Codex becomes a permanent lesson, allowing them to perceive the hidden truths carried within every drop of blood. What once began as a hunting technique has become an unparalleled mastery of life, death, and the countless emotions that bind them together.

The Bloodhunter's Blood Codex has grown into a living archive of every species they have studied. Once the blood of a creature has been absorbed through Blood Communion, its scent can never truly be forgotten. Across years, continents, and countless hunts, the Bloodhunter instinctively recognises familiar blood as though greeting an old enemy.

A master Bloodhunter no longer needs obvious trails to pursue their prey. A single dried droplet hidden upon a weapon, armour, or stone is enough to awaken the creature's Blood Signature. Through Sangramancy, they reconstruct the hunt piece by piece, predicting movements, identifying weaknesses, and uncovering truths that ordinary trackers could never hope to perceive.

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, those who reach this level are known as **Blood Sages**. They are feared not because they cannot be escaped, but because once they have learned your blood, they will never truly lose your trail.

### Effects

- Blood Scent remains a **Passive Talent**.
- You can detect the scent of **fresh blood** within **75 metres**.
- Blood trails remain detectable for up to **30 days**, unless completely destroyed by powerful magical effects.
- You may maintain an **unlimited number of Active Blood Signatures**.
- While hunting a creature whose Blood Signature you have memorised, you gain:
  - **+5 to Survival checks** made to track that creature.
  - **+5 to Perception checks** made to locate that creature.
  - **+4 to Attack Rolls** against that creature.
  - **+4 to Damage Rolls** against that creature.
- You always know the general direction of any memorised Blood Signature while it remains within your Blood Scent range.
- Blood Communion now reveals:
  - The creature's exact species and ancestry.
  - Approximate age and physical condition.
  - Magical corruption, diseases, curses, mutations, and bloodline alterations.
  - Whether the creature is currently under magical influence, possession, or transformation.
  - The approximate strength of the creature compared to your own.
- Blood Communion requires:
  - **10 MP**
  - **1 minute of uninterrupted concentration**
- Completing Blood Communion generates **15 Blood Points (BP)**.
- Every creature species successfully communed with is permanently added to your **Blood Codex**.
- Once a species has been recorded within your Blood Codex, you automatically recognise blood belonging to that species without requiring another Blood Communion.
- The first time you encounter a previously recorded species, the GM should provide any information your Blood Codex has previously learned about that creature.

### Lore

Only a handful of Bloodhunters throughout history have reached the Fifth Rank of Blood Scent. By this stage, their Blood Codex has become one of the greatest repositories of monster lore ever assembled. Every hunt, every battle, and every Blood Communion has added another chapter to a lifetime devoted to understanding the creatures that threaten the world.

Legends tell of Blood Sages who could identify an ancient dragon from a single crimson scale, determine the age of a vampire from one dried droplet upon castle stone, or recognise a demon's blood centuries after it had first stained the earth. To such hunters, blood is no longer merely a trail—it is history itself.

Yet every Blood Communion continues to carry a price. Each absorbed Blood Signature strengthens the Bloodhunter's understanding while adding another emotional echo to the burden they carry. Even the greatest Blood Sages know that mastery over Sangramancy is never complete. They simply learn to shoulder more voices without allowing them to become their own.

> *"Names can be forgotten. Faces can change. Kingdoms can fall. But blood remembers... and so do I."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Prerequisites
None

## Scaling
See individual rank details.

entries.body:
# Hardened Soul

## Overview
Every Bloodhunter knows that monsters do not always attack the body. Some prey invade the mind, whisper to the soul, or awaken fear so overwhelming that even the strongest warriors falter. A Bloodhunter cannot afford such weakness.

The countless emotions absorbed through Sangramancy gradually temper the Bloodhunter's spirit. Every fear conquered, every nightmare endured, and every brush with Bloodlust leaves their soul stronger than before. Rather than hiding from these emotions, the Bloodhunter learns to embrace them, transforming terror into determination.

This discipline is known as the **Hardened Soul**. Instead of allowing fear to control them, the Bloodhunter may willingly draw upon the darkness already growing within. By accepting additional Blood Points, they strengthen their resolve, pushing back against the forces seeking to dominate their mind.

The choice is never free.

Every time a Bloodhunter embraces the darkness, they step one pace closer to Bloodlust. A wise hunter knows there are battles worth risking their soul for—and others where restraint is the greater victory.

## Rank 1
### Description

Every Bloodhunter knows that monsters do not always attack the body. Some prey invade the mind, whisper to the soul, or awaken fear so overwhelming that even the strongest warriors falter. A Bloodhunter cannot afford such weakness.

The countless emotions absorbed through Sangramancy gradually temper the Bloodhunter's spirit. Every fear conquered, every nightmare endured, and every brush with Bloodlust leaves their soul stronger than before. Rather than hiding from these emotions, the Bloodhunter learns to embrace them, transforming terror into determination.

This discipline is known as the **Hardened Soul**. Instead of allowing fear to control them, the Bloodhunter may willingly draw upon the darkness already growing within. By accepting additional Blood Points, they strengthen their resolve, pushing back against the forces seeking to dominate their mind.

The choice is never free.

Every time a Bloodhunter embraces the darkness, they step one pace closer to Bloodlust. A wise hunter knows there are battles worth risking their soul for—and others where restraint is the greater victory.

### Effects

- Hardened Soul is a **Passive Talent**.
- Whenever you are required to make a Saving Throw against becoming **Frightened**, you may choose to activate Hardened Soul **before making the Saving Throw**.
- If you do, immediately gain **5 Blood Points (BP)**.
- You gain a **+2 bonus** to the Saving Throw.
- This decision is entirely optional and must be declared before the Saving Throw is rolled.
- Blood Points gained through Hardened Soul count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.
- Hardened Soul may be used any number of times, provided you are willing to accept the Blood Point cost.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, fear is not considered an enemy to overcome—it is a weapon to master. Apprentices are taught that courage is not the absence of fear, but the willingness to continue despite it. Through years of Sangramancy, they learn that every terrifying emotion can become another source of strength if they are willing to bear its burden.

Veteran Bloodhunters often describe Hardened Soul as opening a door that should never remain open for long. For a fleeting moment, they allow the darkness carried within their blood to rise to the surface, drowning out fear with something far more dangerous. It grants clarity, resolve, and unwavering determination, but every use leaves another scar upon the soul.

Many who succumb to Bloodlust once believed they could always control the darkness. The wisest Bloodhunters understand that Hardened Soul is not about proving one's strength—it is about knowing exactly how much darkness can be embraced before it begins embracing you.

> *"Fear asked me to kneel. I offered it my blood instead."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

The soul of a Bloodhunter is forged through countless encounters with horrors that would shatter ordinary minds. Every monster faced, every Blood Communion performed, and every step taken toward Bloodlust tempers their spirit into something far stronger than mortal resolve.

At this stage, the Bloodhunter no longer steels themselves against fear alone. They have learned that charm, temptation, and false comfort are simply different weapons wielded by the darkness. Rather than allowing these emotions to cloud their judgement, they willingly feed them into the ever-growing storm within their blood.

To outsiders, this appears reckless. A Bloodhunter knowingly embraces the very corruption that threatens to consume them. Yet experienced hunters understand that every choice is calculated. Sometimes allowing Blood Points to rise is preferable to surrendering control of the hunt.

Masters often remind their apprentices that Hardened Soul is not about becoming fearless—it is about deciding which battle is worth risking your humanity. Every use strengthens the Bloodhunter's resolve, but also brings them one step closer to the cold certainty of Bloodlust.

### Effects

- Hardened Soul remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Whenever you are required to make a Saving Throw against becoming **Frightened** or **Charmed**, you may choose to activate Hardened Soul **before making the Saving Throw**.
- If you do, immediately gain **10 Blood Points (BP)**.
- You gain a **+4 bonus** to the Saving Throw.
- This decision is entirely optional and must be declared before the Saving Throw is rolled.
- Blood Points gained through Hardened Soul count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.
- Hardened Soul may be used any number of times, provided you are willing to accept the Blood Point cost.

### Lore

Experienced Bloodhunters eventually realise that monsters rarely rely upon brute strength alone. Vampires seduce, fey deceive, demons tempt, and eldritch horrors whisper promises that slowly erode the will of even the strongest heroes. The greatest danger is often not the monster's claws, but its ability to convince its prey to surrender willingly.

Through relentless discipline, the Bloodhunter learns to recognise these manipulations before they take hold. Instead of resisting through force of will alone, they deliberately awaken the darkness already sleeping within their blood. Terror and temptation are swallowed by Sangramancy, becoming fuel for determination rather than chains upon the mind.

This practice is considered one of the most dangerous teachings within every Bloodhunter Order. Apprentices are warned that each time they embrace the darkness, it becomes easier to do so again. One day they may discover that resisting fear is no longer difficult—not because they have mastered it, but because they have begun to feel nothing at all.

> *"The darkness offered me comfort. I answered by making it carry my burden instead."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

A Bloodhunter who reaches the Third Rank of Hardened Soul has begun to understand one undeniable truth—every emotion is a weapon. Fear, desire, despair, and doubt are no longer obstacles to overcome, but sources of strength waiting to be embraced. Rather than resisting the darkness invading their mind, they willingly pull it into themselves, allowing Sangramancy to consume its influence before it can take hold.

The Bloodhunter's soul has become a battlefield unlike any other. Countless Blood Communions, dangerous hunts, and moments spent standing on the edge of Bloodlust have forged a spirit that refuses to break. Every choice to embrace Blood Points instead of surrendering control strengthens this inner resolve, teaching the Bloodhunter that true courage is not the absence of fear, but the willingness to weaponise it.

Yet this newfound mastery carries a frightening consequence. The Bloodhunter begins to rely upon the darkness. Each successful act of defiance makes it easier to accept more Blood Points, and easier still to justify walking ever closer to Bloodlust. Masters teach that the greatest danger is no longer the monsters outside—but the growing belief that the monster within can always be controlled.

Only the wisest Bloodhunters remember that every choice has a cost.

### Effects

- Hardened Soul remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Whenever you are required to make a Saving Throw against becoming **Frightened**, **Charmed**, or **Mentally Influenced**, you may choose to activate Hardened Soul **before making the Saving Throw**.
- If you do, immediately gain **15 Blood Points (BP)**.
- You automatically **succeed** on the Saving Throw.
- Mental Influence includes magical or supernatural effects that alter your thoughts, emotions, or judgement, as determined by the GM.
- This decision is entirely optional and must be declared before the Saving Throw is rolled.
- Blood Points gained through Hardened Soul count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.
- Hardened Soul may be used any number of times, provided you are willing to accept the Blood Point cost.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, the Third Rank is known as **The Iron Mind**. It is the stage where a hunter no longer fears the whispers of darkness because they have learned to answer them with their own.

Veteran Bloodhunters describe the experience as opening a gate within the soul. For a fleeting moment, every fear, temptation, and doubt is swallowed by Sangramancy and transformed into unwavering resolve. The hunter walks forward untouched while lesser warriors falter.

But every gate opened becomes easier to open again.

The elders caution that many Bloodhunters who eventually succumb to Bloodlust never lost a battle of will—they won too many. Each victory convinced them they remained in control, until one day the darkness no longer needed permission to answer in their place.

> *"The mind can be conquered only once. Mine was conquered by my own will long before any monster had the chance."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

Very few Bloodhunters ever attain the Fourth Rank of Hardened Soul. Those who do have spent years standing upon the edge of Bloodlust, repeatedly choosing discipline over surrender. Their soul has become a fortress forged through suffering, strengthened not by avoiding darkness, but by surviving it.

At this stage, the Bloodhunter no longer fears attempts to dominate their mind. Every supernatural assault is viewed as another opportunity to draw strength from the emotions carried within their own blood. Terror becomes determination. Temptation becomes resolve. Corruption becomes another burden willingly carried so that others never have to.

This does not mean the Bloodhunter is immune to manipulation. Instead, they possess the experience to decide when to embrace Sangramancy and when to trust their own will. Every choice is calculated, every risk deliberate. The Bloodhunter knows that accepting more Blood Points may save their life today, while simultaneously bringing them closer to the moment they lose themselves forever.

The greatest masters teach that Hardened Soul is not measured by how much darkness you can endure—it is measured by knowing exactly when not to embrace it.

### Effects

- Hardened Soul remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Whenever you are targeted by an effect that would cause **Frightened, Charmed, Possession, Mental Influence, or Magical Compulsion**, you may choose to activate Hardened Soul **before making any Saving Throw**.
- If you do, immediately gain **20 Blood Points (BP)**.
- You automatically succeed on the Saving Throw.
- If the effect does not normally allow a Saving Throw, you may instead ignore the effect entirely.
- This decision is entirely optional and must be declared before the effect is resolved.
- Blood Points gained through Hardened Soul count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.
- Hardened Soul may be used any number of times, provided you are willing to accept the Blood Point cost.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, the Fourth Rank is known as **The Crimson Bastion**. Hunters who achieve this level have endured horrors capable of breaking kings, saints, and legendary heroes alike. Their souls have become scarred beyond recognition, yet every scar serves as another layer of protection against those who would seek to control them.

Elders often remind apprentices that the strongest walls are not built from stone, but from sacrifice. Every time a Bloodhunter willingly accepts Blood Points instead of surrendering their mind, they strengthen that wall while simultaneously allowing the darkness within to grow stronger.

This balance defines every master Bloodhunter. They understand that absolute control is an illusion. Instead, they choose to remain one step ahead of Bloodlust, trusting that when the day finally comes to embrace the darkness completely, it will be for a cause worthy of the price.

> *"Every scar upon the soul is another gate the darkness must break before it can claim me."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

A Bloodhunter who achieves the Fifth Rank of Hardened Soul has reached the pinnacle of spiritual discipline. Their soul has endured years of Sangramancy, Blood Communions, and countless moments standing upon the edge of Bloodlust without surrendering completely to the darkness within. While others see corruption as something to resist, the Bloodhunter has learned to confront it, understand it, and ultimately command it.

Their spirit has become a crucible where fear, temptation, madness, and despair are consumed before they can take root. Every mental assault is met not with resistance, but with absolute resolve. The Bloodhunter chooses whether to accept the burden of Blood Points or simply reject the influence altogether, demonstrating complete mastery over the emotions carried within their blood.

This mastery does not mean the Bloodhunter is free from Bloodlust. Quite the opposite. They stand closer to it than any other hunter alive. Every decision to embrace additional Blood Points still brings them nearer to losing themselves forever. The difference is that the choice now belongs entirely to them.

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, those who reach this level are known as **Soulwardens**. They are living proof that Sangramancy can be mastered without abandoning one's humanity, though few survive long enough to earn such a title.

### Effects

- Hardened Soul remains a **Passive Talent**.
- Whenever you are targeted by an effect that would cause **Frightened, Charmed, Possession, Mental Influence, Madness, Corruption, or Magical Compulsion**, you may choose to activate Hardened Soul **before the effect is resolved**.
- You may choose one of the following options:
  - **Embrace the Darkness:** Gain **25 Blood Points (BP)** and automatically ignore the effect.
  - **Stand Firm:** Ignore the effect without gaining Blood Points.
- This decision is entirely optional and must be declared before the effect is resolved.
- Blood Points gained through Hardened Soul count towards your **Blood Point Limit** and may contribute to triggering **Bloodlust**.
- Hardened Soul may be used any number of times.
- This talent only protects against effects that directly influence, control, corrupt, or manipulate your mind or soul. It provides no protection against physical conditions or damage.

### Lore

Very few Bloodhunters ever become Soulwardens. Their souls have endured horrors beyond imagination, yet they continue to walk the line between humanity and monstrosity with unwavering purpose. They understand that the darkness within them will never disappear—it can only be acknowledged, respected, and controlled.

To younger Bloodhunters, a Soulwarden appears almost impossible to intimidate. Ancient vampires, elder demons, and eldritch horrors speak words meant to shatter the strongest minds, yet the Bloodhunter simply continues walking. They have already faced the greatest darkness imaginable—the one growing within their own soul.

The elders teach that Hardened Soul was never about becoming immune to fear or corruption. It was always about choice. Every Bloodhunter must eventually decide whether to embrace the darkness for greater strength or reject it to preserve themselves. A Soulwarden has learned that true mastery is not choosing one path over the other, but knowing precisely when each is required.

> *"The darkness has knocked upon my soul a thousand times. Now it waits politely... because it knows I decide when the door opens."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

entries.body:
# Hunter's Bane

## Overview
Every Bloodhunter eventually discovers that there is one creature they cannot ignore.

Whether born from vengeance, duty, fear, or obsession, every hunter develops a relentless fixation upon a particular kind of prey. Some dedicate their lives to destroying the undead that slaughtered their family. Others swear to eradicate fiends that plague the mortal realm, while others pursue dragons, aberrations, or monsters that ordinary people dare not face.

This lifelong dedication is known as a **Hunter's Bane**.

Through years of study, relentless pursuit, and countless Blood Communions, the Bloodhunter learns every weakness, behaviour, hunting pattern, and instinct of their chosen prey. Their Blood Codex steadily grows with observations gathered from every encounter, making them one of the most dangerous adversaries that creature type will ever face.

Yet obsession comes at a terrible price.

The blood of a Hunter's Bane resonates more violently than any other. Every drop carries stronger emotions, stronger memories, and stronger hatred. Sangramancy eagerly feeds upon these emotions, granting the Bloodhunter greater focus while simultaneously accelerating the accumulation of Blood Points. Against their sworn prey, the Bloodhunter walks far closer to Bloodlust than they ever would against any other creature.

## Rank 1
### Description

Every Bloodhunter eventually discovers that there is one creature they cannot ignore.

Whether born from vengeance, duty, fear, or obsession, every hunter develops a relentless fixation upon a particular kind of prey. Some dedicate their lives to destroying the undead that slaughtered their family. Others swear to eradicate fiends that plague the mortal realm, while others pursue dragons, aberrations, or monsters that ordinary people dare not face.

This lifelong dedication is known as a **Hunter's Bane**.

Through years of study, relentless pursuit, and countless Blood Communions, the Bloodhunter learns every weakness, behaviour, hunting pattern, and instinct of their chosen prey. Their Blood Codex steadily grows with observations gathered from every encounter, making them one of the most dangerous adversaries that creature type will ever face.

Yet obsession comes at a terrible price.

The blood of a Hunter's Bane resonates more violently than any other. Every drop carries stronger emotions, stronger memories, and stronger hatred. Sangramancy eagerly feeds upon these emotions, granting the Bloodhunter greater focus while simultaneously accelerating the accumulation of Blood Points. Against their sworn prey, the Bloodhunter walks far closer to Bloodlust than they ever would against any other creature.

### Effects

- Choose **one creature type** from the following list. This choice is **permanent**:
  - Aberration
  - Beast
  - Celestial
  - Construct
  - Dragon
  - Elemental
  - Fey
  - Fiend
  - Giant
  - Humanoid
  - Monstrosity
  - Ooze
  - Plant
  - Undead
- This creature type becomes your **Hunter's Bane**.
- Gain **+2 to Survival checks** made to track creatures of your Hunter's Bane.
- Gain **+2 to Monster Knowledge checks** regarding creatures of your Hunter's Bane.
- Blood Communion performed on your Hunter's Bane requires only **30 seconds** instead of **1 minute**.
- The first successful Blood Communion performed on your Hunter's Bane immediately records that species within your **Blood Codex** if it has not already been documented.
- If a creature is both your **Hunter's Bane** and your **Marked Prey**, gain:
  - **+1 to Attack Rolls**.
  - **+1 to Damage Rolls**.
- **Whenever you gain Blood Points (BP) from an ability, talent, Blood Communion, Blood Rite, Blood Curse, or any other Sangramancy effect while interacting with your Hunter's Bane, the Blood Points gained are doubled.**
- This doubling is mandatory and cannot be ignored unless another ability specifically states otherwise.

### Lore

Every Bloodhunter carries a story that begins with a single monster.

For some, it is the vampire that slaughtered their village. For others, the demon that corrupted their homeland or the ancient dragon that reduced an entire kingdom to ash. These encounters leave scars deeper than flesh, shaping the hunter's purpose for the rest of their life.

The ritual of declaring a Hunter's Bane is among the oldest traditions of every Bloodhunter Order. Before their peers, the hunter speaks the name of the creatures they will dedicate their life to destroying before sealing the oath with their own blood. From that day onward, every hunt deepens their understanding, but also their obsession.

The elders teach that hatred is the sharpest weapon a Bloodhunter possesses—and the most dangerous. Sangramancy amplifies every emotion carried within blood, and no blood burns hotter than that of a sworn enemy. Many Bloodhunters who succumb to Bloodlust do so not while facing impossible odds, but while standing before the very creature they swore they would one day destroy.

> *"Beware the hunter who knows your blood... but fear the one who has sworn an oath upon it."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
# 

### Description

A Bloodhunter's obsession grows stronger with every successful hunt. What once began as hatred evolves into unparalleled understanding, allowing the hunter to anticipate the instincts, habits, and behaviour of their chosen prey with frightening accuracy. Every battle, every Blood Communion, and every page added to the Blood Codex strengthens the bond between hunter and quarry.

At this stage, the Bloodhunter no longer studies their Hunter's Bane simply to destroy it—they begin to think like it. They recognise territorial patterns, preferred methods of attack, weaknesses hidden beneath instinctive behaviour, and the subtle signs that reveal when a creature is preparing to flee, ambush, or strike.

This deeper understanding comes at an equally dangerous cost. The emotions carried within the blood of their sworn prey resonate far more violently than before. Every encounter awakens powerful feelings of determination, vengeance, and obsession, causing Sangramancy to react with greater intensity. The Bloodhunter becomes increasingly efficient at hunting their chosen enemy, but every victory brings them closer to surrendering themselves to Bloodlust.

Among the Orders, veterans often warn that a Bloodhunter should never allow their Hunter's Bane to become their only purpose. Those who do frequently forget why they became hunters in the first place, until the hunt itself becomes all that remains.

### Effects

- Your Hunter's Bane remains the creature type chosen at Rank I.
- Gain **+3 to Survival checks** made to track creatures of your Hunter's Bane.
- Gain **+3 to Monster Knowledge checks** regarding creatures of your Hunter's Bane.
- Blood Communion performed on your Hunter's Bane now requires only **15 seconds**.
- Blood Communion performed on your Hunter's Bane reveals:
  - The creature's approximate health.
  - Signs of disease, corruption, curses, or magical influence.
  - Whether the creature has recently fought or consumed another creature.
- If a creature is both your **Hunter's Bane** and your **Marked Prey**, gain:
  - **+2 to Attack Rolls**.
  - **+2 to Damage Rolls**.
- Whenever you gain Blood Points (BP) from an ability, talent, Blood Rite, Blood Communion, Blood Curse, or any other Sangramancy effect while interacting with your Hunter's Bane, the Blood Points gained are **doubled**.
- Once your Hunter's Bane has been permanently recorded within your Blood Codex, you immediately recognise blood belonging to that creature type without needing to perform Blood Communion again.

### Lore

Only seasoned Bloodhunters reach the point where instinct begins to rival experience. The Blood Codex grows beyond a simple record of hunts and becomes a detailed study of a single enemy, documenting generations of knowledge gathered by countless hunters before them.

Many Bloodhunter Orders pass these records from master to apprentice, ensuring that no lesson earned in blood is ever forgotten. Over decades, the Bloodhunter develops an uncanny familiarity with their Hunter's Bane, recognising patterns invisible to everyone else and predicting behaviour with remarkable precision.

Yet obsession is never without consequence. Sangramancy rewards dedication with power, but it also magnifies every emotion tied to that dedication. The Bloodhunter must constantly ask themselves whether they are still hunting their prey—or whether their prey has begun hunting them from within.

> *"Know your enemy so completely that they believe escape is possible... right until the moment they realise you were always one step behind them."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

By the Third Rank, your Hunter's Bane has become more than a sworn enemy—it has become your life's work. Years of study, countless Blood Communions, and relentless pursuit have transformed your Blood Codex into a comprehensive record of your chosen prey. Every hunt refines your understanding, allowing you to predict behaviour before it happens and recognise weaknesses invisible to ordinary hunters.

Your Blood Scent reacts instinctively whenever your Hunter's Bane is near. Even the faintest trace of fresh blood can reveal the creature's passing, while your Sangramancy resonates more violently than ever before. Every encounter awakens powerful emotions that sharpen your focus while simultaneously drawing you ever closer to Bloodlust.

Experienced Bloodhunters often describe this stage as becoming one with the hunt. They no longer simply pursue their prey—they begin to anticipate its every decision. Every failed ambush, every attempted escape, and every desperate last stand becomes another lesson added to the Blood Codex.

Yet this mastery carries a terrible burden. The stronger your obsession becomes, the more Sangramancy responds to it. Every drop of blood belonging to your Hunter's Bane burns like fire within your soul, granting incredible strength while threatening to consume your reason. Few Bloodhunters can maintain such discipline for long, and many legendary hunters have ultimately fallen to the very obsession that once made them great.

### Effects

- Your Hunter's Bane remains the creature type chosen at Rank I.
- Gain **+4 to Survival checks** made to track creatures of your Hunter's Bane.
- Gain **+4 to Monster Knowledge checks** regarding creatures of your Hunter's Bane.
- Blood Communion performed on your Hunter's Bane requires only **1 Action**.
- If a creature is both your **Hunter's Bane** and your **Marked Prey**, gain:
  - **+3 to Attack Rolls**.
  - **+3 to Damage Rolls**.
- Gain **Advantage** on checks made to identify, investigate, or recall information about your Hunter's Bane.
- Blood Communion now reveals:
  - Approximate remaining vitality.
  - Active magical effects.
  - Curses, diseases, corruption, mutations, and bloodline abnormalities.
  - Whether the creature has previously been encountered by you.
- Whenever you gain Blood Points (BP) from an ability, talent, Blood Rite, Blood Communion, Blood Curse, or any other Sangramancy effect while interacting with your Hunter's Bane, the Blood Points gained are **doubled**.
- Once recorded within your Blood Codex, you immediately recognise fresh blood belonging to your Hunter's Bane by scent alone.

### Lore

The Third Rank is known among the Bloodhunter Orders as the **Hunter's Awakening**. By this stage, a Bloodhunter has accumulated enough knowledge that hunting their chosen prey becomes almost instinctive. Stories tell of masters recognising a single drop of blood upon stone, immediately identifying not only the creature that shed it but also the direction it travelled and the wounds it carried.

The Blood Codex grows ever larger with every successful hunt. Some Bloodhunters dedicate entire libraries to documenting the habits of a single creature type, ensuring that future generations never begin their hunt without centuries of accumulated knowledge guiding them.

But obsession is a dangerous companion. The Orders teach that every Bloodhunter eventually reaches a point where they must choose whether they control the hunt—or whether the hunt has begun to control them. Those who fail that choice often become legends... remembered as warnings rather than heroes.

> *"The day you understand your prey better than it understands itself is the day the hunt truly begins."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
# 

### Description

Your Hunter's Bane is no longer simply a sworn enemy—it has become an obsession that defines your existence. Years of relentless pursuit have transformed your Blood Codex into an unrivalled archive of knowledge, containing every weakness, instinct, hunting pattern, and behaviour your chosen prey has ever revealed. Every encounter reinforces what you know, making each hunt more efficient than the last.

At this level, your Sangramancy instinctively reacts whenever your Hunter's Bane is near. The scent of their blood immediately sharpens your focus, while your Blood Signature and Blood Codex work together to predict their movements before they are made. Few creatures can deceive a Bloodhunter who has dedicated their life to understanding them.

The Bloodhunter Orders teach that this is the point where hunters stop reacting to monsters and instead begin controlling the hunt itself. Every trap, every pursuit, and every confrontation unfolds according to the Bloodhunter's expectations, forcing even the most intelligent prey into a losing battle.

Yet obsession has now become inseparable from power. Every encounter with your Hunter's Bane causes your Blood Points to surge violently, feeding Sangramancy with emotions that grow stronger with every victory. Many Bloodhunters who reach this level begin to fear not their enemies, but the calm certainty they feel whenever the hunt begins.

### Effects

- Your Hunter's Bane remains the creature type chosen at Rank I.
- Gain **+5 to Survival checks** made to track creatures of your Hunter's Bane.
- Gain **+5 to Monster Knowledge checks** regarding creatures of your Hunter's Bane.
- Blood Communion performed on your Hunter's Bane is completed as a **Bonus Action**.
- If a creature is both your **Hunter's Bane** and your **Marked Prey**, gain:
  - **+4 to Attack Rolls**.
  - **+4 to Damage Rolls**.
- Gain **Advantage** on Initiative rolls whenever your Hunter's Bane is present.
- You cannot be surprised by your Hunter's Bane while it is within the range of your Blood Scent.
- Blood Communion additionally reveals:
  - The creature's approximate remaining Health.
  - Active magical enchantments or curses.
  - Recent injuries and their severity.
  - Whether the creature has consumed, transformed into, or been influenced by another creature.
- Whenever you gain Blood Points (BP) from an ability, talent, Blood Rite, Blood Communion, Blood Curse, or any other Sangramancy effect while interacting with your Hunter's Bane, the Blood Points gained are **doubled**.
- Once recorded within your Blood Codex, blood belonging to your Hunter's Bane is instantly recognised by scent, regardless of age, provided some trace of its essence remains.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, Rank IV is known as the **Master Hunter's Oath**. Hunters who reach this level have devoted so much of their lives to a single enemy that they often understand their prey better than the creatures understand themselves. Every victory becomes another lesson, and every lesson strengthens both the Bloodhunter and the obsession driving them forward.

Many legendary Bloodhunters have ended ancient bloodlines through nothing more than patience. They waited, observed, studied, and struck only when every possible outcome had already been calculated. To such hunters, the battle itself is merely the final chapter of a hunt won long before blades are ever drawn.

The elders warn, however, that the line between mastery and obsession has all but disappeared. The Bloodhunter's hatred has become an inexhaustible source of strength, but Sangramancy eagerly feeds upon that hatred. One careless moment is all that separates a legendary hunter from becoming another victim of Bloodlust.

> *"The greatest hunters do not chase monsters. They become the fate those monsters can never escape."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

You have become the embodiment of the hunt.

Your Hunter's Bane is no longer merely a creature type you specialise in—it has become the purpose around which your Sangramancy has evolved. Every Blood Communion, every Blood Signature committed to your Blood Codex, and every battle fought against your sworn prey has reshaped both your body and mind into the ultimate predator.

The Blood Codex has become a living archive of generations of knowledge, allowing you to understand your Hunter's Bane with frightening clarity. Their instincts, behaviours, strengths, and weaknesses are no longer mysteries. You read them as easily as others read a book, often predicting their actions moments before they occur.

Yet no Bloodhunter reaches this level without sacrifice.

The blood of your Hunter's Bane resonates with overwhelming intensity. Every drop fuels your Sangramancy, causing your Blood Points to surge faster than ever before. To lesser Bloodhunters this would guarantee Bloodlust, but masters willingly walk that razor's edge, accepting the growing burden because no one else can stand against the horrors they were born to destroy.

Among the Orders, those who achieve this rank are known as **Apex Hunters**. Legends claim entire monsters species have altered their migration routes after learning one of these hunters has entered their territory.

### Effects

- Your Hunter's Bane remains the creature type chosen at Rank I.
- Gain **+6 to Survival checks** made to track creatures of your Hunter's Bane.
- Gain **+6 to Monster Knowledge checks** regarding creatures of your Hunter's Bane.
- Blood Communion performed on your Hunter's Bane is **instantaneous** and requires no additional action beyond interacting with the blood.
- If a creature is both your **Hunter's Bane** and your **Marked Prey**, gain:
  - **+5 to Attack Rolls**.
  - **+5 to Damage Rolls**.
- Gain **Advantage** on Initiative rolls whenever your Hunter's Bane is present.
- Your Hunter's Bane cannot gain Advantage against you through being hidden, invisible, or disguised while within the range of your Blood Scent.
- Your Blood Codex immediately identifies any blood belonging to your Hunter's Bane, regardless of its age, provided a trace of its essence remains.
- Blood Communion reveals everything known through previous ranks, as well as:
  - The creature's approximate age.
  - Its bloodline or lineage.
  - Magical mutations or inherited traits.
  - Signs of previous Bloodhunter encounters.
- **Whenever you gain Blood Points (BP) from an ability, talent, Blood Rite, Blood Communion, Blood Curse, or any other Sangramancy effect while interacting with your Hunter's Bane, the Blood Points gained are doubled.**
- This effect is mandatory and cannot be prevented unless another ability specifically overrides it.

### Lore

Very few Bloodhunters survive long enough to become an Apex Hunter. Those who do are spoken of with equal measures of admiration and fear, for they have devoted an entire lifetime to understanding a single enemy so completely that the hunt itself has become instinct.

Entire Bloodhunter Orders preserve the journals of Apex Hunters within their Blood Codices. These writings contain centuries of accumulated knowledge, allowing future generations to continue the hunt where others left off. It is said that no Bloodhunter truly dies while their Blood Codex remains, for every lesson learned in blood continues to guide those who follow.

The greatest irony of the Apex Hunter is that they stand closer to Bloodlust than any other Bloodhunter. Every encounter with their sworn prey floods their soul with overwhelming emotion, pushing them to the brink of losing themselves. Yet they willingly embrace that burden, believing there is no greater sacrifice than becoming the very weapon needed to destroy the monsters that threaten the world.

> *"Every hunter dreams of slaying the monster. Only an Apex Hunter understands that the greatest victory is surviving the monster within."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

entries.body:
# Veinlock

## Overview
A Bloodhunter soon learns that blood is more than life—it is movement. Every heartbeat drives muscles, every pulse fuels strength, and every flowing vein keeps a creature alive. Through Sangramancy, the Bloodhunter can momentarily seize control of that flow, causing the blood within an enemy's body to thicken and resist its natural movement.

This technique is known as **Veinlock**. Rather than inflicting overwhelming pain, the Bloodhunter briefly restricts circulation, causing muscles to stiffen and reactions to slow. The effect is subtle but devastating, robbing even the fastest prey of the speed they rely upon to escape.

Veinlock is most effective against creatures already suffering from open wounds. Fresh blood provides the Sangramancer with a stronger connection to the target, allowing the manipulation to spread more easily through the circulatory system. Veteran Bloodhunters often combine Blood Rite with Veinlock, weakening their prey before closing in for the kill.

The technique is completely ineffective against creatures without circulating blood. Constructs, most undead, oozes, and similar beings simply possess no living blood for the Bloodhunter to command.

## Rank 1
### Description

A Bloodhunter soon learns that blood is more than life—it is movement. Every heartbeat drives muscles, every pulse fuels strength, and every flowing vein keeps a creature alive. Through Sangramancy, the Bloodhunter can momentarily seize control of that flow, causing the blood within an enemy's body to thicken and resist its natural movement.

This technique is known as **Veinlock**. Rather than inflicting overwhelming pain, the Bloodhunter briefly restricts circulation, causing muscles to stiffen and reactions to slow. The effect is subtle but devastating, robbing even the fastest prey of the speed they rely upon to escape.

Veinlock is most effective against creatures already suffering from open wounds. Fresh blood provides the Sangramancer with a stronger connection to the target, allowing the manipulation to spread more easily through the circulatory system. Veteran Bloodhunters often combine Blood Rite with Veinlock, weakening their prey before closing in for the kill.

The technique is completely ineffective against creatures without circulating blood. Constructs, most undead, oozes, and similar beings simply possess no living blood for the Bloodhunter to command.

### Effects

- As an **Action**, target one creature with circulating blood within **15 metres**.
- Spend **15 MP**, sacrifice **5 HP**, and gain **5 Blood Points (BP)**.
- The target must succeed on a **Constitution Saving Throw** against your **Sangramancy DC**.
- On a failed save, the target becomes **Veinlocked** for **2 Combat Rounds**.
- While Veinlocked, the target:
  - Has its **Movement Speed reduced by 50%**.
  - Cannot take the **Dash** action.
  - Has **Disadvantage** on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
- If the target is currently suffering from a **Bleeding** effect, it has **Disadvantage** on the Constitution Saving Throw.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Veinlock at a time.
- Veinlock has **no effect** on creatures without functioning blood unless another Bloodhunter ability specifically states otherwise.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, Veinlock is often the first true display of offensive Sangramancy taught to apprentices. Unlike Blood Rite, which channels one's own blood into a weapon, Veinlock reaches outward, proving that another creature's blood can be manipulated just as easily as one's own.

Many apprentices struggle with the technique at first. They instinctively try to force the blood to stop completely, only to find the connection breaks under such strain. Masters instead teach them to think of a river rather than a dam—slowing the current just enough that the prey begins to stumble under its own weight.

Experienced Bloodhunters know that a fleeing monster is often more dangerous than a cornered one. Veinlock was created not to kill, but to ensure that once the hunt begins, the prey can never outrun the hunter.

> *"Every creature believes its legs will carry it to safety. They forget who commands the blood that moves them."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 2
### Description

With greater mastery of Sangramancy, the Bloodhunter learns that blood does not merely power movement—it dictates timing, balance, and reaction. By exerting finer control over a target's circulatory system, the Bloodhunter can cause muscles to seize at precisely the wrong moment, disrupting even the most disciplined warriors.

The victim feels as though their own body has begun to betray them. Their limbs become sluggish, reactions slow, and every attempt to defend themselves is delayed by a heartbeat. While the effect lasts only moments, those moments are often all a Bloodhunter requires to end the hunt.

Experienced Bloodhunters rarely use Veinlock to simply immobilise prey. Instead, they exploit hesitation. Every delayed step, every failed dodge, and every missed opportunity creates another opening for Sangramancy to inflict greater suffering. When combined with Blood Rite and a well-maintained Bleeding effect, Veinlock transforms even the swiftest enemy into easy prey.

However, manipulating another creature's blood demands greater sacrifice from the Bloodhunter. More blood is offered, more Blood Points are accumulated, and the whispers of Bloodlust grow louder with every successful use.

### Effects

- As an **Action**, target one creature with circulating blood within **20 metres**.
- Spend **20 MP**, sacrifice **8 HP**, and gain **10 Blood Points (BP)**.
- The target must succeed on a **Constitution Saving Throw** against your **Sangramancy DC**.
- On a failed save, the target becomes **Veinlocked** for **3 Combat Rounds**.
- While Veinlocked, the target:
  - Has its **Movement Speed reduced by 50%**.
  - Cannot take the **Dash** action.
  - Cannot take **Reactions**.
  - Has **Disadvantage** on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
- If the target is suffering from a **Bleeding** effect, it has **Disadvantage** on the Constitution Saving Throw.
- If the target is both **Bleeding** and your **Marked Prey**, it also suffers **-2 to Dexterity Saving Throws** while Veinlocked.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Veinlock at a time.
- Veinlock has **no effect** on creatures without functioning blood unless another Bloodhunter ability states otherwise.

### Lore

Bloodhunter veterans describe the Second Rank of Veinlock as the moment Sangramancy changes from simple manipulation into complete battlefield control. Rather than merely slowing prey, the Bloodhunter begins controlling the rhythm of combat itself. A delayed parry, a missed opportunity, or a failed escape often determines the outcome of an entire hunt.

Many Bloodhunters compare the circulatory system to a river. At first they merely slowed its current. Now they learn to create sudden surges and blockages, forcing the body to move against its own instincts. To onlookers, the victim appears exhausted or clumsy. Only another Sangramancer understands that every heartbeat is being manipulated by an unseen hand.

The Orders warn that every successful Veinlock reinforces the Bloodhunter's confidence in controlling another living being. Used carelessly, that confidence may one day tempt the hunter to believe every creature exists only to have its blood commanded—a dangerous belief that has led many promising Bloodhunters toward Bloodlust.

> *"A warrior's greatest strength is timing. Steal a single heartbeat... and you've already won the battle."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 3
### Description

By the Third Rank, Veinlock has evolved beyond simply slowing an opponent. The Bloodhunter can now disrupt the rhythm of a creature's entire circulatory system, causing muscles to seize, reflexes to falter, and limbs to respond sluggishly to even the simplest commands. Every heartbeat becomes a battle between the creature's will and the Bloodhunter's Sangramancy.

At this level, experienced Bloodhunters no longer use Veinlock merely to prevent escape—they use it to dictate the pace of combat. Enemies find themselves unable to reposition, react, or unleash their full strength before the Bloodhunter closes the distance. The technique is especially feared amongst monsters that rely upon speed, overwhelming attacks, or coordinated movements.

The stronger the Bloodhunter's connection to their prey, the more devastating Veinlock becomes. A bleeding target offers countless paths through which Sangramancy may flow, allowing the Bloodhunter to tighten their control with terrifying precision. Many veteran hunters deliberately inflict wounds before invoking Veinlock, ensuring their prey becomes trapped both physically and psychologically.

Despite its effectiveness, Veinlock remains a dangerous technique. Every manipulation of another creature's lifeblood demands a greater sacrifice from the Bloodhunter, feeding Blood Points into the growing storm within their own soul.

### Effects

- As an **Action**, target one creature with circulating blood within **25 metres**.
- Spend **30 MP**, sacrifice **12 HP**, and gain **15 Blood Points (BP)**.
- The target must succeed on a **Constitution Saving Throw** against your **Sangramancy DC**.
- On a failed save, the target becomes **Veinlocked** for **4 Combat Rounds**.
- While Veinlocked, the target:
  - Has its **Movement Speed reduced by 75%**.
  - Cannot take the **Dash** action.
  - Cannot take **Reactions**.
  - Suffers **-1 Action Point** (minimum of 1 Action Point remaining).
  - Has **Disadvantage** on Dexterity Saving Throws.
- If the target is suffering from a **Bleeding** effect, it has **Disadvantage** on the Constitution Saving Throw.
- If the target is both **Bleeding** and your **Marked Prey**, it also suffers **-2 to Constitution Saving Throws** while Veinlocked.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Veinlock at a time.
- Veinlock has **no effect** on creatures without functioning blood unless another Bloodhunter ability specifically states otherwise.

### Lore

Among the Bloodhunter Orders, the Third Rank is known as **The Crimson Grip**. Few techniques inspire greater fear amongst intelligent monsters, for those who have witnessed it know that escape becomes nearly impossible once the Bloodhunter has seized control of their blood.

Masters teach that blood is the language spoken by every living creature. A skilled Sangramancer does not force the blood to obey—they convince it to flow differently, causing the body to betray itself one heartbeat at a time. To outsiders, the victim simply appears exhausted or slow. Only another Bloodhunter understands the invisible battle taking place beneath the skin.

Veterans caution their apprentices that Veinlock should never be used carelessly. Every successful manipulation strengthens the Bloodhunter's confidence in commanding another creature's lifeblood, and that confidence can easily become arrogance. Those who forget that blood is sacred often discover too late that Sangramancy is always willing to command its master as readily as it commands its prey.

> *"The body obeys the blood. Command the blood... and the body has no choice but to follow."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 4
### Description

Master Bloodhunters understand that blood is more than a source of life—it is the thread that binds every movement together. At the Fourth Rank, Veinlock allows the Bloodhunter to seize that thread with frightening precision, disrupting the flow of blood throughout an opponent's body until every movement becomes a struggle.

Victims often describe the sensation as though invisible chains have wrapped themselves around every muscle. Their limbs refuse to respond, their heartbeat becomes uneven, and every attempt to fight against the Sangramancy only causes their own blood to resist them further. Even the strongest warriors find themselves trapped inside bodies that no longer obey.

Against bleeding prey, the technique becomes devastating. Every open wound strengthens the Bloodhunter's connection, allowing Sangramancy to spread effortlessly through the target's circulatory system. Veteran Bloodhunters deliberately combine Blood Rite, Blood Scent, and Veinlock into a relentless sequence—find the prey, wound the prey, then ensure the prey can never escape.

Only creatures with functioning blood can be affected. Those without a living circulatory system remain beyond the reach of this technique, a limitation every Bloodhunter quickly learns to respect.

### Effects

- As an **Action**, target one creature with circulating blood within **30 metres**.
- Spend **40 MP**, sacrifice **16 HP**, and gain **20 Blood Points (BP)**.
- The target must succeed on a **Constitution Saving Throw** against your **Sangramancy DC**.
- On a failed save, the target becomes **Veinlocked** for **5 Combat Rounds**.
- While Veinlocked, the target:
  - Has its **Movement Speed reduced to 0**.
  - Cannot take the **Dash** action.
  - Cannot take **Reactions**.
  - Suffers **-1 Action Point** (minimum of 1 Action Point remaining).
  - Has **Disadvantage** on Dexterity and Constitution Saving Throws.
- At the end of each of its turns, the target may repeat the Constitution Saving Throw, ending Veinlock on a success.
- If the target is suffering from a **Bleeding** effect, it has **Disadvantage** on all Saving Throws made to end Veinlock.
- If the target is both **Bleeding** and your **Marked Prey**, it suffers **1d8 Blood Damage** at the start of each of its turns while Veinlocked.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Veinlock at a time.
- Veinlock has **no effect** on creatures without functioning blood unless another Bloodhunter ability specifically states otherwise.

### Lore

Within the Bloodhunter Orders, the Fourth Rank is known as **The Crimson Prison**. Few techniques inspire greater terror among monsters, for those who survive it often speak of being fully conscious while their own bodies refused every command.

Masters teach that Veinlock is not about overwhelming force. Instead, it is absolute precision. A Bloodhunter learns exactly which veins to constrict, which muscles to starve of blood, and which heartbeat to interrupt. To observers, the victim appears frozen by fear. In truth, they are imprisoned by their own blood.

The greatest Bloodhunters consider Veinlock an act of mercy. A fleeing monster endangers countless innocent lives. By ending the chase before it truly begins, the Bloodhunter ensures the hunt concludes swiftly and with as little unnecessary suffering as possible. Yet every use reminds the hunter how easily Sangramancy can command another living being—and how dangerous such power becomes when restraint is forgotten.

> *"The fastest prey still carries blood. That is all the advantage I require."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor

## Rank 5
### Description

At the pinnacle of Sangramancy, the Bloodhunter no longer merely influences the blood of another creature—they command it. Every heartbeat, every contraction of muscle, and every surge of adrenaline becomes another thread woven into the Bloodhunter's control. To those who witness the technique, it appears as though time itself has slowed around the victim. In reality, it is their own blood refusing to obey.

Master Bloodhunters use Veinlock only when a hunt must end. Ancient dragons attempting to take flight, legendary beasts preparing their final charge, and powerful fiends readying devastating magic have all been brought to a standstill by a hunter who understands the language of blood better than the creature carrying it.

The connection forged through Blood Rite, Blood Scent, and Blood Communion reaches its absolute peak at this rank. A wounded Marked Prey becomes almost impossible to escape with, as every drop of blood flowing through its veins strengthens the Bloodhunter's control.

Yet such mastery demands an immense sacrifice. The Bloodhunter pours an overwhelming amount of Sangramancy into another living being, flooding themselves with Blood Points in the process. Every use brings them dangerously close to Bloodlust, forcing them to decide whether ending the hunt is worth risking the monster growing within.

### Effects

- As an **Action**, target one creature with circulating blood within **35 metres**.
- Spend **50 MP**, sacrifice **20 HP**, and gain **25 Blood Points (BP)**.
- The target must succeed on a **Constitution Saving Throw** against your **Sangramancy DC**.
- On a failed save, the target becomes **Veinlocked** for **6 Combat Rounds**.
- While Veinlocked, the target:
  - Has its **Movement Speed reduced to 0**.
  - Cannot take the **Dash** action.
  - Cannot take **Reactions**.
  - Suffers **-2 Action Points** (minimum of 1 Action Point remaining).
  - Has **Disadvantage** on all Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution Saving Throws.
- At the end of each of its turns, the target may repeat the Constitution Saving Throw, ending Veinlock on a success.
- If the target is suffering from a **Bleeding** effect, it has **Disadvantage** on all Saving Throws made to end Veinlock.
- If the target is both **Bleeding** and your **Marked Prey**, it suffers **2d8 Blood Damage** at the start of each of its turns while Veinlocked.
- Veinlock has **no effect** on creatures without functioning blood unless another Bloodhunter ability specifically states otherwise.
- A creature may only be affected by one instance of Veinlock at a time.

### Lore

The Fifth Rank of Veinlock is spoken of with equal parts admiration and fear throughout every Bloodhunter Order. It is a technique so precise that masters claim it is no longer the Bloodhunter controlling another creature's blood—it is the blood itself recognising the authority of Sangramancy.

Stories tell of Apex Bloodhunters stopping charging giants mid-stride, grounding dragons before they could take flight, and freezing ancient vampires just long enough for the final strike to be delivered. These tales have become legends, yet every Bloodhunter knows they were purchased through immense sacrifice. Such absolute control can only be achieved by allowing the darkness within to rise alongside the power.

The elders warn that Veinlock is the ultimate temptation of Sangramancy. To command another creature's lifeblood so completely is to stand upon the edge of believing all life exists to be controlled. The greatest Bloodhunters never forget that blood is sacred, for the moment they do, the hunt ends—and Bloodlust begins.

> *"Every heart beats to the rhythm of blood. Learn that rhythm... and even legends shall stand still."*  
> — Grand Bloodhunter Serik Vaelor
